scope: diagnostic only; no quarantine records were promoted or re-extracted

detail_record_availability.finding: All 259 audit-counted candidates are represented in retained open_web_quarantine segment artifacts. The apparent 109-record gap came from the prior breakdown's normalized relation deduplication, not from missing logs or a distinct unattributable candidate type.

grouping_method.subject_unlock_definition: Each of the 331 targets had one clean predicate group. A retained quarantine candidate for a target is counted as a possible second relation group for prioritization only; it is not admitted evidence.
grouping_method.candidate_count: raw quarantine records, matching the 259 precision-gate audit count
grouping_method.unique_relation_records: normalized subject, predicate, object, source_url; this removes repeated records from rerun campaign segments
grouping_method.structural_metadata: extraction_pattern (or v2_pattern_id when extraction_pattern is absent)

recommendation.observed_retained_coverage: The top two source groups cover 131 unique subjects (39.58% of 331); all three cover 137 (41.39%).
recommendation.conclusion: This is not a logging gap and not a long source-host tail: the complete 259-record audit is concentrated in exactly three source groups. Three source-specific extractors are the complete observed lane set, but their candidate coverage is 137 of 331 subjects (41.39%), not 60-80%. Their actual relation-density unlock rate remains an empirical question and must be measured without relaxing quarantine.
